wan22.name: Wan 2.2 · Image to Video
wan22.description: Animate a starting image. Reuses your UMT5 text encoder.

ltx2.name: LTX-2 · Audio & Video
ltx2.description: 19B distilled FP8 model. Text or image to video with optional audio; uses CPU offloading on 16 GB GPUs.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut XL v9
juggernaut.description: SDXL model for realistic photography and detailed subjects.

dreamshaper.name: DreamShaper XL Turbo 2.1
dreamshaper.description: Fast SDXL model for illustrations, fantasy and stylized images.

zimage.name: Z-Image-Turbo
zimage.description: Fast text-to-image generation with natural language prompts.

fluxklein.name: FLUX.2 Klein 4B
fluxklein.description: Fast image generation and instruction editing with multiple references.

qwenimage.name: Qwen-Image-2512
qwenimage.description: Detailed image generation with strong typography. Large model; uses RAM offloading.

illustrious.name: Illustrious XL 2.0
illustrious.description: Illustration and anime image generation, redraw and masked editing.

qwenedit.name: Qwen Image Edit 2511
qwenedit.description: Instruction editing with up to three images. Large model; uses RAM offloading.

qwen21.name: Qwen-Image 2.1 · Detail Enhancer
qwen21.description: Optional image enhancement with Elusarca’s detail LoRA. Requires its own Qwen 2.1 base and encoder; originals are kept.
qwen21.license: Qwen Research License; see upstream terms

flux3.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein · INT8
flux3.description: Generate images and make instruction edits with up to ten reference images. Fast distilled model; includes a separate compatible engine.
flux3.license: FLUX Kommunity License; see upstream terms

avatar_echo.name: EchoMimicV3-Flash
avatar_echo.description: Talking portraits from an image and your recording. Recommended starting point for a 16 GB GPU; uses eight sampling steps.

avatar_soulx.name: SoulX-FlashHead · Lite & Pro
avatar_soulx.description: Image and recording to a talking head. Lite favors speed; Pro favors detail. Both variants are included; no microphone or voice service is required.

avatar_longcat.name: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 · Q4
avatar_longcat.description: Expressive image-to-avatar generation with your recording. Uses a memory-saving community GGUF conversion and the matching eight-step distillation adapter; slower and more demanding than the small models.

avatar_infinite.name: InfiniteTalk · Q4
avatar_infinite.description: Animate an image or dub a Library video using your recording. Uses single-speaker weights and a memory-saving Wan 14B GGUF base; multi-speaker conversations are not included in this workflow.

avatar_musetalk.name: MuseTalk 1.5
avatar_musetalk.description: Fast lip synchronization for a portrait or Library video, driven by your recording. Uses portable ONNX face landmarks; preserves the source background and saves a new video.
avatar_musetalk.license: MIT code; commercially usable model weights; third-party component licenses apply

ref2va.name: MiniMax H3 · Ref2VA VSA
ref2va.description: Reference-image to video with optional generated audio, four-step Turbo LoRA and experimental VSA acceleration. Author requirements: 24 GB NVIDIA GPU; smaller cards are unverified. Large download and substantial system RAM required.
ref2va.license: MiniMax H3 Community License; plugin Apache-2.0; Turbo LoRA Apache-2.0

minimax_h3.name: MiniMax H3 · Turbo (Pepe104)
minimax_h3.description: Local text / first-and-last-image to video with generated audio. Uses the Space’s Larry v1 Turbo LoRA, with the newer v4 adapter also available. Quantized local checkpoint; experimental on 16 GB GPUs. Substantial RAM/paging capacity required.
minimax_h3.license: MiniMax H3 Community License; Turbo LoRAs and extension Apache-2.0

viggle.name: Qwen Image 2.1 · Viggle Turbo v0.3
viggle.license: Qwen Research License (base; non-commercial); Viggle derivative: Qwen Research License
viggle.description: Six-step image generation and edits with up to three images. Shares the Qwen 2.1 base, encoder and VAE with the Detail Enhancer. Research/non-commercial license; substantial RAM required.

bfs.name: BFS · Qwen 2.1 Head Swap v1.1
bfs.license: Qwen Research License (base; non-commercial); BFS adapter: MIT
bfs.description: Face/head replacement using a target image and a reference identity. Uses the recommended v1.1 adapter and unaccelerated Qwen 2.1 sampling. Base model has a research/non-commercial license.

realvisxl.name: RealVisXL v5
realvisxl.description: Photorealistic image generation and masked editing. Complete SDXL checkpoint with built-in text encoders and VAE; no separate SDXL base download.
realvisxl.license: See the model author’s license and usage terms.

cyberrealistic.name: CyberRealistic XL v1.1
cyberrealistic.description: Photorealistic image generation and masked editing. Complete SDXL checkpoint with built-in text encoders and VAE; no separate SDXL base download.
cyberrealistic.license: See the model author’s license and usage terms.

krea2.name: Krea 2 Turbo
krea2.description: Fast eight-step text-to-image generation with optional Krea 2 LoRAs. FP8 weights with CPU offloading; reuses the Qwen-Image VAE. This pack generates images; it does not perform instruction edits.

moss_sft.name: MOSS-Image SFT · INT8
moss_sft.description: Text, tags and spatial layouts. Optional fast LoRAs and color/depth maps in MOSS controls. Compact INT8 model and W4A8 text encoder for lower memory use.

moss_sft_bf16.name: MOSS-Image SFT · BF16
moss_sft_bf16.description: Text, tags and spatial layouts. Optional fast LoRAs and color/depth maps in MOSS controls. Full BF16 model and text encoder; substantially more RAM/VRAM needed.

moss_base.name: MOSS-Image Base · INT8
moss_base.description: Text, tags and spatial layouts. Optional fast LoRAs and color/depth maps in MOSS controls. Compact INT8 model and W4A8 text encoder for lower memory use.

moss_base_bf16.name: MOSS-Image Base · BF16
moss_base_bf16.description: Text, tags and spatial layouts. Optional fast LoRAs and color/depth maps in MOSS controls. Full BF16 model and text encoder; substantially more RAM/VRAM needed.

kromoss.name: Kromoss · INT8
kromoss.description: Text, tags and spatial layouts. Optional fast LoRAs and color/depth maps in MOSS controls. Compact INT8 model and W4A8 text encoder for lower memory use.

kromoss_bf16.name: Kromoss · BF16
kromoss_bf16.description: Text, tags and spatial layouts. Optional fast LoRAs and color/depth maps in MOSS controls. Full BF16 model and text encoder; substantially more RAM/VRAM needed.

moss_encoder_w4a8.name: MOSS text encoder · W4A8
moss_encoder_w4a8.description: Optional Qwen3.5-9B precision choice. Identical files used by installed MOSS models are reused.

moss_encoder_int8.name: MOSS text encoder · INT8
moss_encoder_int8.description: Optional Qwen3.5-9B precision choice. Identical files used by installed MOSS models are reused.

moss_encoder_bf16.name: MOSS text encoder · BF16
moss_encoder_bf16.description: Optional Qwen3.5-9B precision choice. Identical files used by installed MOSS models are reused.

moss_vae_full.name: MOSS full VAE
moss_vae_full.description: Optional full decoder with MOSS normalization; reused between all MOSS variants. Choose Small or Full in MOSS controls.

moss_tools.name: MOSS fast LoRAs & color/depth control
moss_tools.description: SFT 8-step DMD, Kromoss DMD/DMD2, and the community color/depth adapter. Configure them in MOSS controls; these are optional and shared by all variants.
